```yaml
name: Push Kubernetes Manifests to GHCR

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  push-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install oras CLI
        run: |
          ORAS_VERSION="v1.0.0"
          curl -L https://github.com/oras-project/oras/releases/download/${ORAS_VERSION}/oras_${ORAS_VERSION}_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin oras
          oras --version

      - name: Package and push manifests
        run: |
          # Create a temporary directory for the manifests
          mkdir -p /tmp/manifest
          cp -r overlays/x86/* /tmp/manifest/

          # Archive the manifests
          tar -C /tmp/manifest -czf /tmp/manifest.tar.gz .

          # Push the archive as an OCI artifact to GHCR
          oras push ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/k8s-manifests:latest /tmp/manifest.tar.gz
        env:
          ORAS_VERSION: v1.0.0

      - name: Verify push
        run: |
          oras pull ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/k8s-manifests:latest -o /tmp/pulled.tar.gz
          echo "Pulled artifact size: $(stat -c%s /tmp/pulled.tar.gz) bytes"
```
